name: rhino-mcp
description: Drive Rhino 7 (macOS) from Claude: modelling, layers, drawings and exports.
long_description: Connects Claude to a running Rhino 7 with the RhinoMCP plugin installed. The bundled bridge talks to Rhino over an authenticated loopback-only connection (127.0.0.1). If Rhino is closed, Claude is told to open it; no restart of Claude is needed. Requires the RhinoMCP plugin in Rhino (see the project's INSTALL.md).
